messages:
emma: Heads up — new price sheet is ready for the A/B rollout. Need to lock down cohort mapping, grandfathering boundaries, and the cutover timeline. Sheet: https://docs.redwood.ai/pricing/2026-q2-new-sheet (view only for now)

raj: Quick Q — do we apply grandfathering to active reserved contracts or only PAYG/monthly subs?

maya: Reserved stays on contract rates per legal. Grandfathering only applies to PAYG and monthly subs created before 2026-04-15T00:00:00Z. We discussed this in last week's sync. :white_check_mark:

josiah: Added a SQL snippet to tag cohorts for the rollout (run in reporting db):
```
UPDATE customers
SET pricing_cohort = CASE
  WHEN created_at < '2026-04-15' THEN 'legacy'
  ELSE 'new'
END
WHERE billing_enabled = true;
```
Run with --dry-run first.

sarah: Invoice question — what about invoices generated during the canary window (some will cross the 4/15 boundary)? We need clear pro-rate rules and an automated patch for invoices that applied the wrong rate. Also need the customer-facing message for grandfathering.

emma: Good point. Plan:
- Canary: 5% of accounts (region = us-west) for 48h.
- If no invoice failures and <0.5% billing regressions, expand to 25% then 100% over 72h.
- For invoices created in the overlap window, we'll apply a post-process: detect mismatched rate and credit the diff automatically. Raj/Maya to own the patch + support playbook.

billing-bot: Scheduled job 'metering-sync' will run 2026-04-18T03:00:00Z (UTC). It will re-ingest last 72h of usage.

raj: I'll draft the rollback playbook: block new rate application at the gateway, backfill old rates on invoices where possible, and issue manual credits for anything that can't be backfilled. Also add a monitoring query to flag >0.2% invoice adjustments in 1h.

maya: Checklist I'm adding to the rollout doc: preflight slices (top 100 customers by spend), reconciles (daily diff), telemetry (invoice error rate, metering lag), support steps + canned messages. Link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/ops/pricing-cutover.

josiah: Note — there's a token-rounding bug in the metering pipeline that can inflate small customers' usage. I have PR #4321 to fix it; ETA deploy 2026-04-17T22:00:00 PT. We should gate the canary until that deploy is live.

emma: Agreed. Gate until PR #4321 is in prod. Also need final approvals from Finance + Legal. @sarah can you confirm legal sign-off on the grandfathered messaging and carrier wording?

sarah: Legal reviewed the messaging; minor wording tweak recommended (no changes to policy). I'm good to sign off once the wording update is in the doc.

emma: OK — action items:
1) josiah: finish and merge PR #4321 (metering fix) — target 4/17 deploy.
2) raj + maya: prepare rollback + invoice-credit automation, run the cohort tagging dry-run this week.
3) maya: publish the support playbook and canned messages.
4) legal (sarah): final sign-off on messaging after tweak.
5) ops: start canary at 2026-04-18T03:00:00Z (5% us-west) once all green.

If anyone sees blockers call out now. Otherwise I'll schedule the canary and post the cutover checklist tomorrow. :rocket:
